newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open weaker, but losses seen limited.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open weaker, but losses seen limited.

text.p: The FTSE 100, up about 11 percent in 1996, opened slightly weaker on Tuesday, the last trading day of the year, after a U.S.-led rally drove the leading UK index into record ground yesterday. At 0837 GMT, the benchmark FTSE 100 was 4.2 points lower at 4,111.5, having closed at its highest point ever on Monday at 4,115.7.
Gilts also opened a touch lower.
The Dow, up about 22 points when London markets closed yesterday, gave up early gains and ended 11.54 points lower at 6,549.37.
